## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 10.09.2026 - 29.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Elijah Quinn_, 29.09.2026, 1/5: "Pretty decent but there's a few bugs that lock up the app and the ads are annoying. (edit: lowered to 1 star because its set up so you have to pay for coins, trash.)"
            2. _Jack Müller_, 10.09.2026, 4/5: "I have ADHD so it's hard for me to stick to a routine or remember to dk stuff in general. This app really helps because it mixes my to does and routines with entertainment! The only downside is that there are a lot of ads if you don't buy premium"
